gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight make Bevellier stand out, with every glyph tucked tight against its neighbor. But Noto Sans Armenian does the gentler work, its round letters wide and inviting.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Stencil-cut and flat, Bevellier holds one stroke weight all the way round. Noto Sans Avestan reads modern and clean, curve tips stopping short of closing, its tall x-height carrying long lines smoothly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Flat and stencil-cut, Bevellier draws every curve without swelling, while Noto Sans Bassa Vah is sans-serif with a dominant midsection. That flat heading against a tall-middled body is the standout.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali is contemporary sans-serif, its letter mouths distinctly open and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase around them. Bevellier's single-weight strokes hold up beside it, no hairlines to squint at.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly spaced, Bevellier keeps a single line weight around every curve. And Noto Sans Bhaiksuki brings swollen, rope-like lowercase letters with open apertures that stay readable.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid is modern, leaving generous room between curve ends and stems, beneath the flat single-weight Bevellier. Its high-set x-height keeps long lines legible and pleasantly unhurried, line after line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic stays clean and modern, with open apertures and ascenders barely clearing the x-height. But Bevellier is the one for attention, its flat stencil-cut strokes holding one constant width.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Under Bevellier, the text feels clean and modern, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward. Noto Sans Gujarati keeps large open counters inside its tall a, s and e, so long lines stay inviting.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Clean and professional text sits under Bevellier, its terminals pointing outward like tongs and ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Noto Sans Gurmukhi lets Bevellier do the showing off with flat, taper-free strokes.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-imperial-a: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly spaced, Bevellier looks almost carved. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads friendly and approachable, its c opening like pincers and capitals sitting only a short step above the lowercase.
